plugin.name: Gods-Eye View Render Service
plugin.description: Generate illustrative scene renders and check render job status and available media URLs. Generated content is not factual evidence.
conversationStarters: Render an illustrative scene of a quiet coastal town at dusk.
Check the status of my render job.
Show the available media URLs for my render.
